## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

An 8-juan Southern Sòng judicial-decision casebook, expanding Hé Níng's *Yí yù jí* ([KR3c0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3c/KR3c0006)) and providing the standard pre-Yuán *yí yù*-genre reference. Composition: bracketed by Zhèng's mid-12th-century working life. The frontmatter brackets to ca. 1131–1180.

**Abstract**

The *Zhé yù guī jiàn* is one of the principal Sòng-period legal-historical reference works. The bibliographic record: *Sòng shǐ yìwén zhì*; SKQS *Zǐbù — Fǎjiā lèi*.
